install_nougat_ocr_package: install the nougat-ocr python package with pip using setup.py and all core dependencies
install_nougat_api_extras: install the nougat-ocr package with api extras for fastapi and uvicorn server support
install_nougat_dataset_extras: install the nougat-ocr package with dataset extras for pytesseract and pdfminer dependencies
run_nougat_console_script: run the nougat console script entry point from predict:main to convert PDFs to LaTeX
run_nougat_api_server: run the nougat_api console script entry point from app:main to start the FastAPI server
